## Rejected after full-size checks
- Marko Pavlichenko's sunset trainer shots: the tail carries "SkyEagle Aviation Academy" and registration N32YA (a real flight school).
- Tunafish's terminal window: large "FLIGHT DECK TOKYO" airport signage.
- The rest of Will Haddock's cockpit series: "VENTURE WEST" livery and N-registrations visible.

- A man on a laptop call (prominent Apple logo), a calculator photo (Casio/BIG brand marks and a handwritten personal email address) and a desk flat-lay (Dell logo, a phone showing a person).

## Still needed
- Real photos of the MASAR team or MASAR's own work, when available, would be stronger than stock.
